name: Block Inspection (Streamed)
definition: Streamed volume block inspection by opening a second streamed volume over the same store, cropped to picked brick's common-grid box, letting octree pull crop toward level 0.
summary: Block Inspection (Streamed) enables high-resolution inspection of a specific region in a streamed volume by opening a secondary cropped volume instance that leverages the octree to serve finer detail levels without extracting data into memory.
